title: CDW Expands AI Ecosystem Through New DevRev Alliance Built Using OpenAI Models
summary: New alliance combines DevRev's AI-native platform, OpenAI model capabilities and CDW's services expertise to help organizations move from AI experimentation to measurable business outcomes CDW (Nasdaq: CDW), the strategic end-to-end technology partner that turns customer ambition into outcomes, today announced a new go-to-market alliance with DevRev , the enterprise AI platform that automates resolution of customer and employee requests, using OpenAI models. The alliance will combine CDW’s services expertise with DevRev’s AI platform with a goal to help organizations automate routine customer and employee service requests. DevRev uses OpenAI models to help automate those requests. As organizations move beyond AI experimentation and focus on deployment at scale, many are seeking practical ways to apply AI within existing business processes and workflows.
